description: A crypto project's total value locked per day (USD, with its staking part) for up to 3650 days, and its TVL on each chain it runs on: the latest value and share, plus one point per day (at most 365 days back) with chain_history=yes. Chain projects carry their chain's TVL and no chain split. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The project's slug; find it with find_projects.

name: project_tvl_history
title: Project TVL history
